# This design's own definitions.
#
# Merged over the built-ins per entry, so what is here adds to them rather than
# replacing the file. See `server/definitionStore.ts`.

apiVersion: elderlygate/designer/design/v2
kind: Definitions
metadata:
  id: definitions
spec:
  vocabulary:
    door-state: [free, held, ajar, faulty]
  properties:
    holdDays:
      label: Hold
      type: number
      hint: days a door is held before the parcel moves to the depot
    reviewed:
      label: Reviewed
      type: flag
    slaLabel:
      label: SLA
      type: text
      hint: hours, as the contract writes it
    answered:
      label: Answered
      type: date
    decided:
      label: Decided
      type: date
